main_text.l: וַיָּקָם et surrexit, pro וַיָּקוּם, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. קום
וַתָּקָשׁ et difficilis fuit, apoc. pro וַתִּקְשֶׁה, fut. Piel, 3. f. fæm. conv. R. קָשָׁה
וַיַּרְא et vidit, f. et vidisti, v. apoc. pro וַיִּרְאֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. vel 2. f. m. R. רָאָה
וַתֶּרֶב et major fuit, apoc. pro וַתִּרְבֶּה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. רָבָה
וַיָּרָם et elevata fuit, pro וַיָּרוֹם, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. רוּם
וַיָּרֶם et extulisti, pro וַיָּרִים, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. conv. Rad. רוּם
וַתָּרַע et makefecisti, pro וַתָּרֵעַ, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. conv. Rad. רוּעַ
וַתִּרְצֶה et acquievisti, v. et acquievit, f. apoc. pro וַתִּרְצֶה, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. conv. Rad. רָצָה
וַיָּרָץ et cucurrit, pro וַיָּרִיץ, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. רוּץ
וַתָּשָׁב et illa reversa est, vel turevertus es, pro וַתָּשׁוּב, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. vel 2. f. masc. conv. Rad. שׁוּב
וַתַּשְׁקֵּ et illa bibendum dedit, apoc. pro וַתַּשְׁקֵה, fut. Hiph. 3. f. fæm. conv. R. שָׁקָה
וַתָּשַׁר et illa cecinit, pro וַתָּשִׁיר, fut. kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. שִׁיר
וַתִּשְׁתֶּ et illa bibit, vel tu bibisti, apoc. pro וַתִּשְׁתֶּה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. vel 2. f. m. conv. Rad. שָׁתָה
וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ et illa se incurvavit, apoc. pro וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. fæm. conv. Rad. שָׁחָה
וַתֵּתַע et illa aberravit, Gen. 21. 14. apoc. pro וַתִּתְעֶה, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. conv. Rad. תָּעָה

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible; several vowel points and the apocopated forms are blurred in the scan and may be wrong. Marked lines needing check: the Hebrew of the "et illa bibendum dedit" line, "vel turevertus es" (printed as "vel tu reversus es"; the scan is smudged here) and the Hebrew in "et makefecisti". The running head and the page number at the top are too faint to read reliably and are left out. The Hebrew letter at the bottom right is not transcribed. Mixed Hebrew and Latin text is kept as printed.
